description:
* 2 bedroom 2 bathroom apartment *

Find the perfect 2 bed apartment located in U Clonsilla.

This brand new 2 bedroom apartment offers plenty of space for you. Comprising of 2 double bedrooms, both with built in wardrobes, 2 bathrooms (one en-suite), beautiful balcony so you can always take advantage of the natural light. Open plan living, making your home feel larger, with fully equipped modern kitchen and separate laundry room. Fully furnished with high-quality fit out, ready for you to enjoy coming home.

For more information, please head to our website www.ubyurbeo.com
